1) 从告警标签取 error 字段确认错误类型；2) NOT_LEADER_O: 1) Take the error field from the alert labels to identify the error type; 2) NOT_LEADER_OR_FOLLOWER usually means partition leaders are moving — check whether the cluster is rebalancing; 3) For REQUEST_TIMED_OUT, check broker load and disk IO; 4) For authentication/authorization errors, verify the client's ACLs and credentials.
1) 从告警标签取 operation_name 确认是哪类操作失败（上传、下载: 1) Take operation_name from the alert labels to identify which operation is failing (upload, download, delete); 2) Find the matching S3 error code in the broker log and separate permissions (403), throttling (503 SlowDown) and network timeouts; 3) For throttling, ask the object storage side to raise the quota or reduce write concurrency; 4) For permissions, verify the AK/SK and bucket policy; for network issues, check connectivity and bandwidth to the object store.
1) 从告警标签取 topic 与 consumer_group，用 kafka: 1) Take topic and consumer_group from the alert labels and run kafka-consumer-groups.sh --describe --group <group> to see the LAG distribution per partition; 2) Lag concentrated on a few partitions means data skew — check the producer's partition key; 3) Evenly spread lag means slow consumers: check the consumer logs for abnormal retries, then add consumer instances (never beyond the partition count); 4) Confirm the consumers have not all dropped out.
1) 在各 broker 上确认进程存活与到 controller quorum: 1) On each broker confirm the process is alive and can reach the controller quorum; 2) In KRaft mode run kafka-metadata-quorum.sh --bootstrap-server <broker> describe --status to check the quorum; 3) When the count is 0, restore the failed controller nodes first — the cluster elects automatically once the majority is back; 4) When it is above 1, investigate the network partition and then stop the minority side so the cluster reconverges.
1) 找出消费流量最大的 topic 与消费组；2) 确认是否有消费组在做全量回: 1) Identify the topics and consumer groups with the highest consume traffic; 2) Check whether a consumer group is doing a full replay from the beginning — this is the most common cause of an outbound traffic spike; 3) Check whether there are far more consumers than needed, and whether groups consuming the same topic can be merged; 4) Add brokers or NIC bandwidth as needed.
1) 检查生产端的 batch.size 与 linger.ms——过小会导致每: 1) Check the producer's batch.size and linger.ms — values that are too small mean one request per message; 2) Raising linger.ms lets the producer batch and dramatically reduces the request count; 3) Check whether producers have compression enabled (compression.type); 4) Combine with broker CPU to judge whether to scale out.
1) 用 kafka-topics.sh --bootstrap-server: 1) Run kafka-topics.sh --bootstrap-server <broker> --describe to count partitions per topic and find the ones that are clearly oversized; 2) Check whether the partition count matches actual throughput — many topics are sized by guesswork; 3) Partitions can only be added, never removed, so shrinking means creating a new topic and migrating; 4) Delete long-idle abandoned topics — that is the quickest win.
1) 用 kafka-topics.sh 结合 topic 级流量指标找出流量最: 1) Use kafka-topics.sh together with per-topic traffic metrics to find the highest-traffic topic; 2) Determine whether it is natural growth or a client resending abnormally; 3) If producers have no compression, enable compression.type=lz4/zstd — that usually cuts bandwidth immediately; 4) Once confirmed, add brokers or NIC bandwidth as needed.
1) 用 ss -tn state established '( sport =: 1) Run ss -tn state established '( sport = :9092 )' | awk '{print $5}' | cut -d: -f1 | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn to see which clients the connections come from; 2) Tell more client instances apart from a connection leak (producers/consumers not being reused); 3) As an emergency measure raise the broker's file handle limit; 4) For the root cause, make clients reuse connections and confirm there is no short-lived reconnect pattern.
1) 看 broker 的磁盘 IO 与 page cache 命中——Fetc: 1) Check broker disk IO and page cache hit rate — slow Fetch usually means cold data being read from disk; 2) Check whether a consumer is replaying from a very old offset and pulling large amounts of cold data; 3) Check whether network bandwidth is saturated; 4) If it persists, add brokers or memory to raise the page cache hit rate.
1) 看 broker 的磁盘写入延迟与网络带宽是否打满；2) 确认 acks: 1) Check broker disk write latency and whether network bandwidth is saturated; 2) Check the acks setting — with acks=all latency follows the slowest replica, so look for lagging replicas; 3) Run kafka-topics.sh --describe --under-replicated-partitions to confirm replication is healthy; 4) If the storage side is clearly the bottleneck, add brokers or move to faster disks.
1) Check the consumer count together with fetch.min.bytes / fetch.max.wait.ms — values that are too small cause busy high-frequency polling; 2) Raising fetch.min.bytes makes consumers batch their fetches and significantly reduces request count; 3) Check whether consumers are spinning (polling frequently with no data); 4) Combine with broker CPU to judge whether to scale out.
AutoMQ 访问对象存储（S3）的失败率偏高。AutoMQ 把数据直接存在对象: AutoMQ's object storage (S3) failure rate is elevated. AutoMQ stores data directly in object storage, so S3 failures directly cause read/write failures and data backlog.
Broker 返回的错误请求速率偏高，客户端的生产或消费请求正在失败。: The broker's error response rate is elevated: client produce or consume requests are failing.
Fetch 请求 P99 延迟超过 1 秒，消费端拉取变慢，消费延迟会随之扩大。: Fetch request P99 latency exceeds 1 second: consumers pull more slowly and consumer lag will grow accordingly.
Kafka Broker 连接数过多: Kafka broker has too many connections
Kafka 每秒 Fetch 请求超过1000: Kafka fetch requests exceed 1000 per second
Kafka 每秒 Produce 请求超过1000: Kafka produce requests exceed 1000 per second
Kafka 请求 S3 失败率较高: Kafka S3 request failure rate high
Kafka 请求错误率过高: Kafka request error rate too high
Kafka 集群入向网络流量较高: Kafka cluster inbound network traffic high
Kafka 集群出向网络流量较高: Kafka cluster outbound network traffic high
Produce 请求 P99 延迟超过 100 毫秒，生产端写入变慢，上游应用会: Produce request P99 latency exceeds 100 milliseconds: producers write more slowly and upstream applications will see send blocking or dropped messages.
分区总数超过 5000。分区过多会显著拉长 controller 故障切换时间、: The total partition count is above 5000. Too many partitions significantly lengthens controller failover, increases metadata sync overhead and inflates file handle usage on every broker.
单 broker 每秒 Fetch 请求数超过 1000，请求频率偏高会放大 C: A single broker is serving more than 1000 Fetch requests per second; that request rate amplifies CPU and network overhead.
单 broker 每秒 Produce 请求数超过 1000，请求频率偏高会放大: A single broker is serving more than 1000 Produce requests per second; that request rate amplifies CPU and network overhead.
单个 broker 的连接数超过 1000，连接过多会消耗大量内存与文件句柄，继: A single broker has more than 1000 connections; too many connections consume significant memory and file handles, and further growth will start rejecting new connections.
消费组的消费位点明显落后于日志末端，下游看到的数据延迟在持续扩大。: The consumer group's committed offset is clearly behind the log end offset and the data delay seen downstream keeps growing.
集群中活跃 controller 数量不等于 1。为 0 说明没有 contro: The number of active controllers in the cluster is not 1. Zero means there is no controller and partition leader election and metadata changes are stalled; more than one means split brain and the metadata may be inconsistent.
集群入向网络流量超过 50MB/s，接近网卡与对象存储上传带宽的压力区间，继续增: Cluster inbound network traffic is above 50MB/s, approaching the pressure range of the NIC and object storage upload bandwidth; further growth will push write latency up.
集群出向网络流量超过 50MB/s，消费侧拉取压力大，继续增长会推高 Fetch: Cluster outbound network traffic is above 50MB/s: consumer pull pressure is high and further growth will push Fetch latency up.
